item.title: Let's Walk!! Garret Mountain — Sat Jul 25, 9:30 AM
item.description:
Let's Walk!! Join me for the 5K paved loop at Garret Mountain Reservation. We will meet at the parking lot on the loop by Park Road. GPS Address for Garrett is 8 Mountain Ave Woodland Park.
Garret Mountain Reservation, located in both Woodland Park and Paterson, is one of Passaic County’s most frequented parks. The original landscape was designed by the famed Olmsted Brothers Firm. The 310 acres of recreational space sits more than 500 feet above sea level, with scenic views of Paterson and the New York City skyline. Lambert Castle and Lambert Tower, two of Passaic County’s historic sites, are also located within Garret Mountain Reservation.
Rain or extreme weather will cancel the event.
Collaborative walk with "Montclair Women Over 50."
Disclaimer: If you join us for a hike, please understand that you are responsible for your own preparedness and well-being and will hold no one else liable in case of injury or mishap.
Source: Meetup: Let's Walk!!

item.title: Art Closing: Linda Antoinette Nelson at Montclair Brewery — Sun Jul 26, 4:00 PM — Montclair Brewery
item.description:
Come out for one final look at the works of our artist-in-residence: Linda Antoinette Nelson! Linda Antoinette Nelson is a NJ native and multimedia artist and an active member of the African American Cultural Committee at the Montclair Art Museum. Her work ranges from vibrant acrylic paintings inspired by nature and everyday moments to symbolic mixed-media compositions that explore identity, resilience, and social awareness. Whether celebrating the beauty of a summer landscape or weaving together visual metaphors and portraiture, her work invites viewers to pause, reflect, and find connection in the world around them. item.title: Pickering Valley Watershed Hike — Sun Jul 26, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Metrotrails: NJ, PA, NY Metropolitan Area Hiking and More! Join us for this interesting point to point hike in the Pickering Creek watershed outside of Phoenixville PA. After meeting at the Schuylkill Township Municipal Building, where there is a park, we will shuttle with as few cars as possible west to the Bryn Coed Preserve. Our day will start out hiking some of the trails through here we had not done in the past, then make our way to Historic Yellow Springs via pleasant back roads. Here, we'll walk a partial loop trail we've not yet done called North Ridge Trail. A couple more back roads lead us to Pine Creek Park where we'll pick up the trails along the Pickering. There will be a combination of creekside tails and pleasant backroads. Distance will be 15 miles. Contact me at 908 343 8374 if needed.
Source: Meetup: Metrotrails Hiking

item.title: A.I.M by Kyle Abraham: White Space — Thu Sep 17, 7:30 PM
item.description:
Run Time: 1 hour White Space brings together acclaimed composers, Jason Moran and Nico Muhly, for a haunting new collaborative score that pierces the heart of choreographer Kyle Abraham’s newest evening-length dance. At just over one hour, this dance work grounds its cast of 11 captivating dancers in a restless and thought-provoking world fueled by a vast movement vocabulary consisting of Abraham’s signature blend of classical and contemporary dance with a hip-hop underbelly. The score is performed live by two pianists on one piano, with echoes of pre-recorded hip-hop driving the collision of reality and idealism. “lush movement, infectious music and magnetic dancers…” (The New York Times)
About A.I.M by Kyle Abraham: Celebrating its 20th anniversary throughout 2016, A.I.M by Kyle Abraham has, for nearly two decades, been at the forefront of contemporary dance, becoming one of the most acclaimed touring companies in the world. A.I.M has been featured in Vogue, Essence, among many

item.title: Compagnie Hervé KOUBI: Sol Invictus — Thu Oct 15, 7:30 PM
item.description:
Run Time: 75 minutes, no intermission. A jubilant ritual full of love and light from the acclaimed French-Algerian ensemble Compagnie Hervé KOUBI. Named after the “invincible sun” deity, Sol Invictus upholds love as the guarantor of peace, that despite fracture, communion emerges as humanity’s saving grace. A vivid celebration of solidarity and the bonds that unite us, in Sol Invictus the sun will emerge victorious. The score includes a composition by Swedish composer Mikael Karlsson, with excerpts by Steve Reich and digital composer Maxime Bodson. “The dancers of Compagnie Hervé KOUBI could be mistaken for gods.” (The New Yorker) About Compagnie Hervé KOUBI: Absolutely unique and utterly original, this fearless, powerful company reigns from France, Algeria, and beyond. Combining contemporary and urban dance movements, capoeira, and martial arts with powerful imagery and inspired choreography, the dancers defy gravity.
Source: PEAK Performances at MSU

Each session takes a closer look at a new or complex topic—whether it's a trending app, an emerging technology, or a platform you've been hearing about but aren't quite sure how to navigate. Through demonstrations and clear, jargon-free explanations, you'll come away with a better understanding of the tech landscape around you. There's no hands-on component, so no devices are needed—just come ready to learn and ask questions.
All are welcome regardless of experience level, and time is reserved at the end of each session for Q&A. Sessions are free and open to the public.
This week's topic is: AI-Generated Images

item.title: Introduction to Wheel Throwing Pottery NEW — Tue Jul 21, 4:00 PM — Montclair - Offsite
item.description:
Note: This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
Discover the art of working on the potter’s wheel in this hands-on 6-week introductory course. Whether you're a complete beginner or looking to refine basic skills, this class offers a welcoming environment to explore the fundamentals of working with clay on the wheel.
You’ll learn the essential techniques of centering, pulling, shaping, and trimming clay to create functional forms like bowls and cups. As the course progresses, you’ll be introduced to glazing methods and the firing process, transforming your pieces into finished, food-safe ceramics. By the end of the session, you’ll have several unique, handmade pieces to take home and enjoy.
All clay, glaze, firings and tools are included.
For the first class, bring an apron or work clothes, sketchbook, writing implement and your curiosity!

item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Jul 22, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream
